title: Fort Christian, Charlotte Amalie
geometryBasis: Mapped Fort Christian perimeter and courtyard, with the four battered bastions, exposed gray-white harbor walls, green shutters, and red Gothic clock tower of the December 2011 views. The outer relation, courtyard, and original independent ground are retained.
sectionBasis: The gate approach is the terrain-contact datum. The courtyard and threshold are estimated at 0.37 meters above it. Exterior wall and tower heights are estimated from the waterfront photo and the documented scale of the footprint.
limitations: December 2011 exterior with the white and weathered waterfront masonry visible in the two cleared photographs. The clock tower and north entry are the Gothic Revival addition described in the landmark nomination.
Precise gate profiles, clock ornament, parapet repairs, rear openings and absolute elevations are approximate. The NPS nomination confirms the building configuration and open court.
The original elevation samples are preserved. Neighboring buildings, exhibits, historic weapons and room interiors are outside the model.
